title: Quotio: your command center for all things AI coding  #github
description:
Juggling AI accounts? Not anymore. Meet Quotio, your command center for all things AI coding. Whether it's Claude, Gemini, or OpenAI, Quotio unifies them into one sleek, native macOS menu bar app. No more switching tabs — track quotas, monitor usage, and manage your AI tools in real-time. 

https://github.com/nguyenphutrong/quotio
